title: Northglade Therapy — Virtual Counselor Assistant Intake (scratchpad)
content:
Meeting: Northglade Therapy — product + engineering intake
Date: 2025-07-18 (initial kickoff)
Attendees: Maya (RW CS), Ethan (RW Solutions), Ravi (RW SRE), Dr. L. Park (Northglade PM), S. Ortiz (Northglade Eng lead), K. Winters (Clinical ops)

Quick summary:
- Northglade wants a small pilot: virtual counseling assistant for intake triage + coping-resource suggestions. Not replacing clinicians.
- Primary constraints: HIPAA compliance, US-only data residency, strict PII redaction in logs, optional on-prem/private control plane.
- Goal: 6-week pilot with 500 sessions/month, <250ms median token latency for short prompts, and human-in-loop escalation for high-risk responses.

Notes / requirements captured (rough):
1) Data & compliance
   - PHI must not be routed through public shared models unless covered by BAA and customer signs off. They prefer Private (VPC) or Dedicated with encryption-at-rest + KMS.
   - Audit logs: retention 1 year; must support redaction or filtered export for legal review.
   - Consent flow: transcripts labelled and stored only if user opts in. Default ephemeral.

2) Safety & escalation
   - Clinical safety: classifier to detect crisis language (suicidal ideation, self-harm) -> immediate escalation to clinician queue. Need confidence threshold tuning.
   - Require dual-model approach: base open model for general convo + smaller fine-tuned safety checker (on-prem) to reduce hallucination risk.
   - No medical diagnosis claims — responses must include safe disclaimers and signpost to clinician contact.

3) Session management / continuity
   - Users expect short-term memory across session (context window ~3–4 prior turns). They do NOT want long-term profile persistence by default.
   - KV cache/prefix caching useful for latency; but must ensure cached context does not leak PHI between sessions/tenants.

4) Performance & infra
   - Target p95 response time for a single-turn prompt (avg 40-80 tokens) < 800ms. Ideal: <500ms.
   - Expected concurrency: 20–40 concurrent sessions during peak. Consider Dedicated pool with autoscale/burst.
   - Cost sensitivity: they'd consider quantized model variants if quality acceptable; ask for A/B quality/cost report.

5) Integrations & product UX
   - Integrate with their scheduling system (internal API) to surface clinician contact details.
   - Allow conversation export (redacted) to clinician dashboard.
   - Web chat + mobile SDK; need short streaming responses and partial-output to show typing indicator.

Gotchas / red flags (observed or flagged by Northglade):
- They emphasized legal signoff first (legal + clinical ethics). No infra work until they confirm BAA path.
- Concern about false positives in crisis classifier -> clinician fatigue. Must minimize false alarms.
- Logging: they insist logs are encrypted and that the default retention is short; they will request a playbook for how we handle subpoena requests.
- On-prem option: their IT wants an air-gapped mode for some clinics. That is higher effort (deployment + training + ops runbook).
- Multi-region requirement: US-only but multiple regions (east/west) for failover. Routing policy needed.

Open questions / unresolved items:
- Which open models are acceptable baseline? (Northglade's clinical board prefers open-source models over closed APIs, but will consider Redwood hosted if under BAA.)
- Exact latency SLO that legal will accept for triage flow (tradeoff w/ cost).
- Clinician review UX — do they need full transcript or summary? (They hinted summary + highlights preferred.)
- Data residency: is Dedicated in a single region enough or do they need per-clinic isolation?

Immediate next steps / action items:
- Maya: draft BAA & product brief for legal review; share template with Northglade by 2025-07-22. (ASSIGNED)
- Ethan: prepare two infra options + rough cost delta (Dedicated reserved + Private VPC) and quantized model cost projection. Due 2025-07-25. (ASSIGNED)
- Ravi: prototype crisis-classifier evaluation plan and false-positive tuning metrics; include sample dataset needs. Due 2025-07-28. (ASSIGNED)
- Northglade: confirm clinical ethics board availability for a 30-min review next week; provide list of prohibited language/phrases. (ACTION: Dr. Park)

Brainstorm / design notes (informal):
- Can use Redwood Optimize to suggest model-quantization configs for latency/cost sweet spot. Prepare an initial comparison (ggml q4_0 vs int8) with sample prompts.
- Consider creating a templated consent flow snippet + redaction middleware in the client SDK to default-mask PHI fields (names, IDs) before sending.
- Fallback policy: if safety-checker confidence low but assistant gives clinical advice, route to clinician or show neutral "I can't help with that, will connect you to a clinician"

Links & references to attach to final PRD:
- crisis-classifier spec (placeholder): confluence:therapy-assistant-privacy-guidelines
- pilot acceptance criteria: JIRA NGTP-58 (see linked_artifacts)

Random scratch / fragments: 
- "short-term memory only" = good selling point to clinical ops
- need explicit log-hygiene doc for subpoena scenarios
- challenge: streaming + safety check (do we stream partial output and then redact? implement buffer until safety pass?)

Notes to self:
- Follow up with legal to get BAAs template — don't spin infra until confirmed.
- Put clinician-in-loop flow into SOW as hard requirement (escalation SLA 5 min?).

Status: Draft intake. Lots of clinical/legal dependency. Prioritize legal + classifier baseline before moving to infra.

-- end of scratchpad (will clean up for PRD if pilot agreed)
